script.spoken: Carriages sank and burned, and forty seven people died. An Amtrak train plunged off a bridge into an Alabama bayou. Minutes earlier, a barge had hit the bridge in thick fog. The towboat pilot didn't realize it was a railway bridge. The impact bent the track out of line. But the rails didn't break, so the signals stayed green. The train reached the kink at full speed. Towboat crews then had to be trained to use their radar.
